verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Post-Incident Reviews feature (formerly Jeli) explicitly builds chronological incident narratives from the incident lifecycle and Slack data via the Scribe Agent, and helps coordinate follow-up actions — covering part of the 'draft from timeline' and learning-loop story. However, there is no evidence of a template library, an explicit review/approval step, or a publication mechanism for postmortems. Missing for 10: named template support, explicit review workflow, and a documented publication/sharing step for finished postmortems.
